findings.title: read_file joins a caller-controlled path onto the configured root
findings.description: The read_file helper in reader.py joins the caller's path onto the root directory without a containment check, so a path with parent-directory segments can read files outside the root. The scanner reported the function but not a line.
findings.impact: A caller who controls the path can read any file the process can read.
findings.exploit_scenario: A request passes ../ segments as the path and receives a file outside the root.
findings.recommendation: Resolve the joined path and reject it unless it stays under the root.
preconditions: The caller controls the path argument.
